name: Input field library
description: Text, select, and textarea with label, helper text, and the default / focus / error / disabled states.

name: Choice controls
description: Checkboxes, radio group, and an on/off switch: the three ways to capture a boolean or a pick.

name: Range & number
description: A slider with a live value read-out and a stepper number input with − / + controls.

name: Search with autocomplete
description: A search input that filters a suggestion list as you type. Try typing “rock” or “june”.

name: Multi-step form
description: A checkout-shaped wizard (details, delivery, payment) that advances with Back / Next, keeping the rest hidden. Click Next.

name: File upload / dropzone
description: A drag-and-drop target with a browse fallback and a list of selected files, framed as adding a photo to a review.

name: Cookie consent
description: A consent banner with accept / reject and a link to preferences. Click a button to dismiss it.
